results.title: Pokémon Unite Is Shutting Down in March 2027 on Nintendo Switch and Mobile
results.description: Pokémon Unite will end service on March 23, 2027, at 8 PM ET/5 PM PT, affecting players on both Nintendo Switch and mobile. The post Pokémon Unite Is Shutting Down in March 2027 on Nintendo Switch and Mobile first appeared on iPhone in Canada.
